issues.parameter: classification / donor Roche-lobe filling / pre-polar status
issues.competing_evidence: Schmidt+05 §§5–6/Table 3 proposes a possible pre-polar and underfilling donor. Szkody+08 §3/Table 2 finds ellipsoidal K-band modulation compatible with filling/near-filling; noncontact 0.82–0.94 R_contact models also fit.
issues.why_it_matters: Detached/semi-detached state and pre-polar interpretation affect subtype/evolutionary comparisons; evidence does not establish one pathway.
issues.needed_action: Retain magnetic CV/LARP as confirmed and pre-polar as proposed/disputed; review competing fill-state models before choosing donor state.

issues.competing_evidence: Szkody+03 gives ≤10000 K from a DA comparison under adopted radius/distance. Szkody+08 infers ≈8400 K from SED and adopts 8000 K at logg=8 without formal uncertainty. Szkody+04 secondarily reports Ferrario+02 5000–8000 K; original Ferrario model not accessed.
issues.why_it_matters: A single displayed WD temperature affects temperature comparisons; sources mix an upper limit and a model adoption.
issues.needed_action: If one value is needed, choose 8000 K with caveat or show ≤10000 K; retain all alternatives separately.

issues.parameter: X-ray converted-band flux and absorption convention
issues.competing_evidence: Szkody+04 has original two-epoch spectral fits with NH fixed at 1.3e20 cm-2. 4XMM-DR11 has two detections and native mean 0.2–12 keV flux. Ridder+23 gives approximate 1–10/0.1–10 keV catalog conversions; exact source band-vector/NH/absorption mapping was not reconstructed.
issues.why_it_matters: Band and absorption conventions affect cross-source comparisons and luminosities.
issues.needed_action: Reproduce exact 4XMM conversion if possible or retain Ridder values as approximate; keep original Szkody fit and native catalog flux separate.

J1955+0045 audit: Table lists X-band flux 79 +/-5 uJy with circular polarization -2 +/-6 percent, Porb=1.3932 h, distance=171 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table.
